coordinator.case: Find the three most downloaded text-generation models under 1B parameters on Hugging Face and tell me their licenses.
Go to books.toscrape.com, open the Travel category, and list every book title with its price.
Write a Python script that gets the Open-Meteo forecast for Pune for the next 3 days, saves it as a CSV, and tells me which day is coolest.
Check which of these packages have a newer version on PyPI than what I pinned: requests==2.31.0, numpy==1.26.0, flask==2.3.0.
Find the top 5 Hacker News stories about Rust and summarize what each one is about.
Look up arXiv papers on speculative decoding, pick the 3 most relevant, and build me a reading list with one-line summaries.
Benchmark how fast Python's json module parses a 50 MB file on this machine versus a 5 MB file and explain the scaling.
On quotes.toscrape.com, collect every quote by Albert Einstein across all pages and save them to a file.
For each of the 3 most downloaded Qwen models on Hugging Face, open its model page and record the license and the weights file size.
Find known vulnerabilities for the Python package jinja2 version 2.10 using OSV and tell me if I should upgrade.
Make a chart of the last 30 days of daily maximum temperature in Mumbai from Open-Meteo and save it as a PNG.
Read the Wikipedia article on the transistor and write me a one-page history with key dates.
Find the latest version of the Python packages fastapi and pydantic, then write and run a script that checks if my installed versions are older.
Open the Hugging Face page of SmolLM2-360M-Instruct, read the model card, and tell me what it was trained on.
